metadata.name: xlsximport
metadata.description: (base64) - parse .xlsx bytes (base64) into a genesis worksheet of cels (layer 'xlsx'). One sheet, number/string values.

metadata.name: xlsxexport
metadata.description: (segment?) - serialize a grid segment's value cels (default 元) to a .xlsx file, returned base64. Round-trips with xlsximport.

metadata.name: xlsxload
metadata.description: (base64) - parse .xlsx bytes (base64) and MATERIALIZE them into the live sheet (the xlsx worksheet of cels)

metadata.name: xlsxopen
metadata.description: () - browser file picker: choose a .xlsx and import it into the sheet

metadata.name: xlsxsave
metadata.description: (segment?) - export a grid segment to .xlsx and download it (default 元)
